Hi Badger

Please submit a bug report on github linked below. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues

If your able, please capture a debug log of the crash using adb and attached it with the bug report. This will help the developers identify and fix the issue.

A guide to complete this is linked below. See "Method B: Using a PC with ADB" https://thunderbird.github.io/thunderbird-android/docs/latest/user-guide/troubleshooting/collecting-debug-logs.html

You can obtain the previous release (v17) apk from either F-droid or github and downgrade Remove the current version and install the downloaded apk. https://www.thecustomdroid.com/how-to-install-apk-on-android/

F-Droid releases: https://f-droid.org/packages/net.thunderbird.android/ Github releases: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/releases
